summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the Gemini AI Suite (concierge, admin copywriter, specials image generator) plus regression on schedule/settings/auth. 13/13 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend flows verified end-to-end on desktop (concierge multi-turn + refusal, admin copywriter renders 3 variants, image generator surfaces exact 402 quota toast) and mobile (concierge launcher does NOT overlap sticky mobile order bar).
critical_code_review_comments: backend server.py has grown to ~450 lines; AI endpoints could be split into /app/backend/routers/ai.py for maintainability but not blocking.

gemini_text() model fallback swallows the underlying exception message and only logs type name — in production consider logging str(exc)[:200] for the last attempt to speed up debugging (image endpoint already does this correctly).
MENU_PAYLOAD in MenuConcierge.tsx is sent from client on every request (~5KB) — fine for now but the backend could load menu server-side to avoid trusting client input for grounding.
get_current_admin returns 401 for both 'not authenticated' and 'not authorized' — semantically the latter should be 403; keeps blackbox tests simpler though.
seed_data_creation: ai_chats sessions created during concierge tests (session_ids prefixed 'sess-'). Non-destructive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest: /app/backend/tests/test_ai_suite.py — reuse. Gemini text model fallback chain works: text calls succeed within ~5-15s even when 3.8/3.7 return 503. Image generator ALWAYS returns HTTP 402 with the exact user-facing message 'Gemini image models aren't included in your key's free tier quota. Enable billing on the Google Cloud project behind your AI Studio key to switch this on.' due to free-tier quota on the current GEMINI_API_KEY — this is expected until billing is enabled and the frontend AiStudio surfaces it as a Sonner toast (auto-dismiss ~8s, poll fast when asserting). Concierge grounding verified: correctly quoted The Kayo Box at $18, refused pizza/sushi and pivoted to 'Oh Manok' Asul Quesadilla. Multi-turn memory verified via db.ai_chats history. Mobile viewport 390x844: concierge-launcher bottom=748 sits above sticky-mobile-bar top=758 — no overlap.
